name: Trump National Doral Miami
insider_take: This legendary resort sits on 800 acres of pristine grounds, home to the famous Blue Monster golf course that has challenged PGA Tour pros for decades.
whats_special: Trump National Doral features four championship golf courses, including the iconic Blue Monster that hosts the WGC-Cadillac Championship. The resort underwent a $250 million renovation, transforming it into a luxury destination with a 50,000-square-foot spa and multiple dining venues by renowned chefs.
pro_tip: Book tee times early for the Blue Monster course, and don't miss the resort's signature BLT Prime steakhouse for dinner with views overlooking the golf courses.
dont_miss: The resort's central location puts you just 10 minutes from Miami International Airport and 20 minutes from South Beach. Take advantage of the world-class spa treatments and explore the nearby Dolphin Mall for shopping, or venture into downtown Miami's vibrant nightlife and cultural scene.
pros: Championship golf courses designed by Gil Hanse
Full-service luxury spa and wellness facilities
Multiple dining venues including BLT Prime steakhouse
Extensive meeting and event spaces for business travelers
cons: Located away from Miami Beach and downtown attractions
Premium pricing for golf and spa services
